start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Lowerby Bus Company.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Zinnia Bay Island Lines.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Hartfell Field Station.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Foxglove Marine Laboratory.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Elmstead Transit Cooperative.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Oakenshaw Sky Survey.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Elmstead Farmers' Union.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Ashgrove Theatre Company.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Gullwing Waterworks Authority.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Marrowgate Coach Lines.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.

start.README.md:
# Incident archive

Everything here was exported from the incident tracker of Brindlemoor Theatre Company.

* `incidents/` holds one record per incident, in whichever format the commander used at the time:
  `*_report.txt` (formal report), `*.warroom.log` (chat log from the war room) or `*-summary.eml` (email summary).
* `addenda/` holds later amendments. An addendum that reclassifies a root cause is final and overrides the original record.
* `notes/` is general office chatter and is not part of the incident record.

Conventions: durations are measured from the first alert to the moment service was restored. An incident belongs to
the calendar month of its date of incident. Severity SEV-1 is the worst.
